questionText: [Part 1 Photograph: Two business professionals reviewing a project chart at a whiteboard] Listen to the four statements and select the one that best describes the photograph.
optionA: They are discussing information displayed on a whiteboard.

optionC: One of the men is erasing the marker board.
optionD: The chairs are being stacked in the corner.
